```yaml
name: Check Milestone
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - release/7.0
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - release/7.0
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]

jobs:
  check-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '7.0.x'

      - name: Check if PR is properly labeled
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request" ]]; then
            PR_NUMBER="${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
            echo "Checking labels for PR #$PR_NUMBER"
            
            # Get labels for the PR
            LABELS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/labels" | \
              jq -r '.[].name')
            
            # Check if any label matches the pattern for backport
            BACKPORT_LABEL_FOUND=false
            for label in $LABELS; do
              if [[ "$label" == *"backport"* ]] || [[ "$label" == *"release/7.0"* ]]; then
                BACKPORT_LABEL_FOUND=true
                break
              fi
            done
            
            if [[ "$BACKPORT_LABEL_FOUND" == false ]]; then
              echo "Error: This PR does not have a proper backport label (e.g., 'backport', 'release/7.0')."
              exit 1
            fi
            
            # Verify the PR references the correct issue
            PR_TITLE="${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
            if ! [[ "$PR_TITLE" == *"Backport PR #4063"* ]]; then
              echo "Error: PR title should reference the original PR #4063."
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Validate files changed
        run: |
          # Check if the expected files are modified
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
          
          EXPECTED_FILES=(
            "Directory.Packages.props"
            "src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient/netfx/ref/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.csproj"
            "src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient/src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.csproj"
            "tools/specs/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.nuspec"
          )
          
          for file in "${EXPECTED_FILES[@]}"; do
            if ! echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "^$file$"; then
              echo "Error: Expected file $file was not modified."
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          
          echo "All expected files are present in the changes."

      - name: Verify package reference
        run: |
          # Check that System.Data.Common v4.3.0 is referenced in Directory.Packages.props
          if ! grep -q "System.Data.Common.*4.3.0" Directory.Packages.props; then
            echo "Error: Directory.Packages.props does not contain System.Data.Common v4.3.0 reference."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check that PackageReference exists in netfx project
          if ! grep -q "System.Data.Common" src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient/netfx/ref/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.csproj; then
            echo "Error: netfx project does not contain System.Data.Common PackageReference."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check that PackageReference exists in main project
          if ! grep -q "System.Data.Common" src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient/src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.csproj; then
            echo "Error: main project does not contain System.Data.Common PackageReference."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check that nuspec contains the dependency
          if ! grep -q "System.Data.Common.*4.3.0" tools/specs/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.nuspec; then
            echo "Error: nuspec does not contain System.Data.Common v4.3.0 dependency."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All package references verified correctly."

      - name: Verify XML comments
        run: |
          # Check for explanatory XML comments in netfx project
          if ! grep -A5 -B5 "System.Data.Common" src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient/netfx/ref/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.csproj | grep -q "inbox version predates"; then
            echo "Error: netfx project missing explanatory XML comment about inbox version."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for explanatory XML comments in main project
          if ! grep -A5 -B5 "System.Data.Common" src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient/src/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.csproj | grep -q "inbox version predates"; then
            echo "Error: main project missing explanatory XML comment about inbox version."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for explanatory XML comments in nuspec
          if ! grep -A5 -B5 "System.Data.Common" tools/specs/Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.nuspec | grep -q "inbox version predates"; then
            echo "Error: nuspec missing explanatory XML comment about inbox version."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All XML comments verified correctly."

      - name: Verify branch status
        run: |
          # Ensure we're working on release/7.0 branch
          CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
          if [[ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" != "release/7.0" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Not on release/7.0 branch."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check if branch is up-to-date with upstream
          git fetch origin release/7.0
          LOCAL_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          REMOTE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse origin/release/7.0)
          
          if [[ "$LOCAL_COMMIT" != "$REMOTE_COMMIT" ]]; then
            echo "Warning: Branch is not up-to-date with origin/release/7.0"
            echo "Local commit: $LOCAL_COMMIT"
            echo "Remote commit: $REMOTE_COMMIT"
          fi
          
          echo "Branch verification completed successfully."
```
